frequency_question: How often do called indefinite strikes by major bank union coalitions actually commence on or before the deadline without being averted by last-minute settlements or court interventions?
membership_rule: Includes any formal call for an indefinite strike by a recognized multi-union banking federation; excludes purely local or single-bank strikes, and strictly token one-day strikes.
coverage_note: 8 major finalized strike calls identified for UFBU over the period; others were averted earlier in conciliation.
known_gaps: Minor regional actions or very short-notice calls might be undercounted.
multiplier: 5 hits / 8 total formal strike calls that reached final countdown stage
validity_reason: Labor negotiation patterns and conciliation frameworks in the public/banking sector evolve slowly over multi-year cycles.
